### 1. Patreon Creator Tiers & Pricing

#### Matt and Shane’s Secret Podcast
- **Grandfathered Poors:** $1 / month *(Sold Out)*
- **The Professional Class:** $5 / month *(Most Popular / entry active tier)*
- **Divine Order of the D.A.W.G.Z.:** $10 / month
- **G.O.D. L.E.V.E.L.:** $50 / month

#### Chris Sain
- **All-Star:** $10 / month *(Recommended by creator; Discord access, watchlist stocks, morning briefings, direct Q&A)*
- **Super-Star:** $20 / month *(All-Star perks + higher support tier)*
- **Legend:** $100 / month *(All previous perks + top support tier)*

---

### 2. ChatGPT Plans & Pricing

#### Individual Plans
- **Free:** $0 / month (unlimited standard text chats with GPT-5.6 Luna, limited uploads, voice, context, and deep research)
- **Go:** $8 / month (expanded messages with tools, more uploads/images/voice, longer memory; may include ads)
- **Plus:** $20 / month (advanced reasoning models GPT-6 Astra / 5.6, expanded research, Codex, projects/tasks, no ads)
- **Pro:** From $100 / month (pro reasoning with GPT-6 Astra, 5x usage, maximum Codex/deep research/memory)

---

### 3. HellHades Membership Feature Note
- **Plans & Costs:**
  - Common: Free
  - Uncommon: £4.99 / month (or £49 / year)
  - Rare: £9.99 / month (or £99 / year)
  - Epic: £19.99 / month (or £199 / year)
  - Legendary: £29.99 / month (or £299 / year)
- **Feature Check:** **No plan specifically mentions interface improvements or automation features.** Perks are strictly centered on Raid Optimiser remote token allocations (75/wk on Free up to unlimited on Legendary), queue priority, ad removal on the website, Discord roles/channels, and early beta testing access.

---

### Budget-Minded Recommendation

If you are working with a very lean monthly subscription budget:

1. **Ultra-Low Budget ($5 to $13 / month):**
   - Pair **The Professional Class** on Matt and Shane's Patreon (**$5/mo**) with **ChatGPT Free ($0/mo)** or **ChatGPT Go ($8/mo)**. 
   - Total cost: **$5 – $13/mo**. You get regular access to creator content while staying well under standard $20 software subscriptions.

2. **Mid-Range / Balanced Budget ($15 to $30 / month):**
   - If investing insights are your primary priority, take Chris Sain's **All-Star** tier (**$10/mo**).
   - If you only need occasional AI help, keep **ChatGPT Free ($0)** for a total of **$10/mo**.
   - If you need paid ChatGPT capabilities alongside one creator, pair **ChatGPT Go ($8/mo)** with Matt & Shane ($5/mo) = **$13/mo**, or with Chris Sain ($10/mo) = **$18/mo**.
   - Stepping up to **ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo)** alongside either entry creator tier pushes the total to **$25 – $30/mo**.

3. **HellHades Takeaway:**
   - Because HellHades does **not** provide automation or UI overhauls, you do not need to factor it into your monthly bill unless you actively exhaust the 75 free weekly Optimiser tokens provided by the Common (Free) plan.
